split: validation.chronological_split, 60/20/20 on complete kickoff dates, FBS-involved completed games

feature_candidates.live: v5.1 conference table + lagged scoring proxy computed in the feature path
feature_candidates.drop: v5.1 conference table + EPA channel off (PPP fallback)

stage_1_selection: lowest validation moneyline Brier under the served v5.1 arithmetic with no key multipliers (tie-free Normal point masses); tiebreak higher validation discrete margin log score

stage_2_key_numbers.fit: fixed-point multipliers on TRAIN so expected |margin| counts match observed
stage_2_key_numbers.validated_if: validation discrete margin log score improves over 'none' with a date-clustered 95% CI above 0 AND validation spread-cover log loss at archived closing lines is not worse than 'none' (point estimate); among validated sets the highest validation discrete log score wins; otherwise 'none'

holdout: read once by the holdout stage (marker file); served v5 vs selected v5.1; never used to choose
baseline: served cfb-structural-v5: v5 features, v5 artifact parameters, 200k NB engine
note: The 2024-11..2026-11 window was already scored by v5's 2026-11-12 fit and the 2026-11-21 slope recheck; it is not a pristine holdout for NCAAF research in general, only untouched by this fit's choices.
